content: In word embeddings, the context of the word INLINEFORM0 is defined to index the surrounding words in a small window around it. Here the context of the word INLINEFORM1 will be the original context ( INLINEFORM2 ) and any equations ( INLINEFORM3 ) that are in a possibly larger window around it. This is referred to as the word-equation context window.
